Author: Ambuj Nath

 In The High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi

 Amit Kumar Pandit --- --- Petitioner
 Versus

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
--- 
For the Petitioner: Mr. Sabyasanchi, Advocate For the O.P-State: Mr. Sunil Kr. Dubey, A.P.P.
---
05 / 14.06.2024 Heard the parties.

2. Petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Sahibganj (T) P.S. Case No. 24 of 2024 for the offences registered under sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471 and 120B/34 of the Indian Penal Code and section 7 of Lottery Regulation Act, 1998, pending in the court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Sahibganj.
3. On 23.02.2024 Officer-in-charge, Town Police on the basis of confidential information, raided the tea stall of Md. Shahrukh Alam @ Vikky and apprehended him along with other accused persons.
On search, lottery tickets were recovered from their possession.
It is alleged that they were selling lottery tickets which has been banned by the State Government.

4. It was submitted that the petitioner was neither apprehended at the spot, nor anything incriminating was recovered from his possession and his name had transpired in the confession of the apprehended accused persons.
It was further submitted that offence alleged is made out under section 7 of Lottery Regulation Act, 1998.
It was further submitted that section 7 of Lottery Regulation Act, 1998 is a penal offence which is punishable with imprisonment for a period of two years or with fine or both.
5. Mr. Sunil Kumar Dubey, learned A.P.P has opposed the prayer for bail.

sentences.text: Offence alleged is specifically covered under section 7 of Lottery Regulation Act, 1998 which is punishable with imprisonment for a period of two years, or with fine or both.
7. Considering the aforesaid facts, I am inclined to extend the privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

Accordingly, petitioner, above named, is directed to surrender before the learned court below within two weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order and the learned court below on his surrender, shall release him on bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 25,000/- (Rupees twenty-five thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Sahibganj in connection with Sahibganj (T) P.S. Case No. 24 of 2024, subject to the conditions as laid down under section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
